data.name: Welcome to the Zoo! 🦁 Tycoon
data.description:

🦁 Build the most amazing zoo! Start with a few cute bunnies and grow a huge park full of lions, giraffes, elephants, pandas, unicorns... and even DRAGONS! 🐉

✨ WHAT'S NEW
🐾 All animals and pets redesigned in cute 3D
🔥 NEW legendary pet: the Phoenix!
🎯 Daily and weekly challenges
❤️ Visit your friends' zoos and like them
🏳️ Create a team and climb the ranking
🔄 Trade pets with your friends
🚨 Catch escaped animals before everyone else
🦭 Sea lion show, carousel, meerkats, red pandas
⭐ Zoo stars: permanent bonuses after every rebirth
👑 Royal Safari: white lions, white tigers, golden pandas, crystal dragon
🎃 Halloween event from October 17!

🥚 Hatch rare pets, fuse them into gold and diamond
🌟 Find rare GOLDEN animals
🎁 Daily rewards and codes
🎮 Play on PC, mobile, tablet and console

🎟️ Free code: JENNESYS

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite for more updates!

Build your dream zoo, care for amazing animals, and turn a small park into a world-famous attraction!

💌 Get your approval letter
🚐 Drive to Happy Paws Adoption Center
📜 Pass your interview and take your pet home
🍖 Feed, bathe and care for it as it grows

🐉 Rare pets arrive daily. Collect them all and get rares!!

data.name: Collect a Zoo!
data.description:
🦁 Welcome to Collect a Zoo!

How to Play:
⚡ SPEED – Upgrade your speed to race players to the center eggs!
🐣 HATCH – Grab eggs from the map to unlock rare zoo animals
💰 EARN – Stack up passive cash per second with every animal you collect
🛖 BUILD – Expand your zoo and discover giant sizes & mutations!

👍 LIKE & FAVORITE THE GAME FOR MORE UPDATES & CODES! ⭐

🎮 Supports PC, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players

data.name: [🎃] Build A Zoo
data.description:
🐼 Welcome to Build A Zoo! 🦒

Start with an empty plot and grow it into the best zoo on Roblox!

🔨 BUILD enclosures, paths and decorations your way!
🐧 ADOPT animals, from playful penguins to giant elephants!
🍖 FEED your animals and keep them happy and healthy!
🚧 FIX broken fences fast, or your animals might escape!
🎟️ ATTRACT guests and earn money from every visit!
👷 HIRE staff to help run your zoo!
💾 SAVE your progress and keep building anytime!


❤️ Having fun? Like and favorite to help Build A Zoo grow!
